# make: make --no-print-directory -n replay-test HISTORY=h.json
# laug: laug health replay h.json
# lease: absent
# file: h.json {"events":[{"eventId":"1"}]}
# compare: whole go
# moved: health internal/health
[ -z 'h.json' ] || [ -s 'h.json' ] || { echo "laug · HISTORY="'h.json'" is not a file with a history in it" >&2; exit 2; }
cd health && REPLAY_HISTORY='$ROOT/h.json' go test ./... -run Replay -v -count=1 2>&1 | grep -E '^(---|ok|FAIL|go: |# |\./[^[:space:]]+\.go:[0-9]+|\s+replay_test)'
